Keysight Technologies Inc reported revenue of 1846000000.00 for the quarter ended 2026-07-31 with net income of 397000000.00, representing growth on a year earlier of 1.078534 [D1]. The company provided guidance for the fourth fiscal quarter of 2026 revenue in the range of 1930000000 to 1950000000 with non-GAAP earnings per share expected between 3.34 and 3.4 [D1]. The stock closed at 333.42 with a forward price to earnings of 20.6612 and an immediate resistance high edge at 366.41 [Facts].

Market participants are arguing about the sustainability of order levels given that supply chain constraints are expected to act as a governor on near-term revenue conversion for the next several quarters [D4]. Analysts have raised price targets substantially above current trading levels, with one target sitting at 400 [D2], while the stock has gained 8.5% over the past four weeks to close the last trading session at 321.87 [D5]. The company noted that it ended the quarter with cash and cash equivalents totaling 2605000000.00 and generated free cash flow of 403000000.00 [D3].

The plan therefore is to maintain focus on deconstraining the supply chain while leveraging strong demand in AI infrastructure, particularly wireline revenue which exceeded wireless revenue for the first time this quarter [D3]. Management expects to have 80% to 90% of the cost synergies realized on a run rate basis exiting the fiscal year as integration efforts are largely complete [D3]. The company will participate in upcoming investor conferences including the Goldman Sachs Communacopia + Technology Conference on Friday, September 11, 2026 and the 2026 Truist Technology Symposium on Tuesday, September 15, 2026 [D6].
